notes.title: Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!

I know some of you have been experiencing issues with Steam Achievements not unlocking properly.

I haven't been resting idle though - I spent all day working on a patch! Early testers report that achievements are now working consistently on PC... and Steam Deck too?!

This fix is now live for everyone to try.

I'm really grateful to everyone who has been patient with me as I figured this out, and a huge thank you to everyone who reported these issues and helped with testing!

Of course, if you continue to have achievement issues, definitely let me know.

More exciting news coming later this week, stay tuned! ✨

Josh[/p]

notes.title: Update: Double Inputs and BitDefender False Positives
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Josh here! 👋

Two quick updates:

[b]🎮 Controller Double Input Fix[/b]
I saw a couple reports of users getting double letters with a single button press on the name entry screen. I'll be honest, I couldn't reproduce this on my end, but I've added some extra safeguards that should prevent any double inputs. Can you let me know if it worked? If you're still experiencing issues, please share your setup details (especially what type of controller you're using) so I can dig deeper!

[b]🛡️ BitDefender False Positive[/b]
BitDefender Antivirus is incorrectly flagging Firefly Village as malicious - specifically the node.dll file (which is a standard component of NW.js that tons of games use). I've submitted a ticket to BitDefender support and hopefully they'll whitelist it soon. In the meantime, the game is completely safe - this is just an overzealous antivirus detection.

What's next?

🗣️ Tilly is STILL sometimes speaking Chinese in the English version despite my previous "fix". She just really wants to impress you with her multilingual abilities! I'll have another chat with her about sticking to one language at a time.

🎯 Steam Deck achievements are still being stubborn. Steam Deck support is new territory for me, and I definitely underestimated the challenge. But I have a few more ideas up my sleeve, so hopefully we'll crack this soon!

Thank you as always for your patience and support! 💚
Josh

notes.title: A bunch of bug fixes!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 👋[/p][p]It's been two days since launch! To everyone who has bought the game, thank you so much!!
I've been monitoring your posts, and just pushed a new update live!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490997/8e021362100d5dd093c408c496488c823e006d2a.png"][/img][/p][p]It sounds like a lot of you were jumpscared by this debug screen today! 😅 That should be resolved now. Sorry about that... that's the last time I push a "quick fix" before bed!

That's not all:

🏆 [b]Achievements[/b] seem to be working for more people now. Still sounds like they're not working for some of you though? Let me know if you're still having issues (and if you're playing PC or Steam Deck).

🌍 There was a bug where Tilly rarely spoke Chinese in the intro regardless of language settings. That should be fixed too, but as always, let me know if it resurfaces.

🎮 [b]Steam Deck[/b] should now show the correct buttons instead of keyboard keys.

✍️ There were a few minor typos fixed too!

Thanks for being patient with me and continuing to provide excellent bug reports. It's wonderful having a community like you! ❤️[/p][p]Josh[/p]

notes.title: Achievement Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Josh here 👋
Thank you so much to everyone who bought the game!

I know I don't post much in the forums, but I am reading all of your feedback. 📖
And a common issue I'm seeing is that achievements aren't triggering for many of you!

I think I found the bug and squashed it.  Version 1.3.3.31 is now live! ✨
If achievements still aren't triggering after updating, please let me know!
(And let me know if you're playing PC or Steam Deck - they both work differently!)

I'm also working on a few more bugs you all reported (multi-lingual Tilly , Steam Deck glyphs).

Please keep them coming! I want to make a game you love! ❤️

Thanks for your patience!
Josh

notes.title: It's happening! Firefly Village's Release Date!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!  Josh here!
[/p][p]First, thank you so much for the overwhelmingly positive support during Next Fest![/p][p]Indie.io and I decided to give this game an official release date: [b]August 11[/b]!

[/p][p][i]...Wait, WHAT!? That's less than a month away!? [/i]😱

[/p][p]Yeah...
Real talk though, the game is in a pretty solid place at this point. I think it genuinely feels complete.
[/p][p]I also got the opportunity to partner with [i]Level Up Games[/i] to create a fully translated Simplified Chinese build of the game! Localization work is tough, but they really did a great job with it.
[/p][p][b]Check out our fancy release date announcement trailer:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d0lKx47sCKI"]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d0lKx47sCKI[/url][/p][p]Here's what you can expect from Firefly Village:
[/p][p]🏡 Get your own small, super cozy farm. Use it to grow crops, raise animals, or ditch it and go fishing. It's your life, there's no wrong way to play. 
[/p][p]⏰ Enjoy the faster paced days, or slow them down in settings. The game's tempo fits your playstyle. 

❤️ I never considered myself a writer, but playtesters seem to really like my characters... I hope you enjoy getting to know them too! They're pretty wacky, but lovable too. 
[/p][p][b]Don't forget to wishlist and follow Firefly Village on Steam![/b] I can't emphasize enough how much wishlists help the game reach a bigger audience.
[/p][p]Thank you! Your support means everything to an indie dev like me.
Josh[/p][p]
[/p]
